rounds.text: Jayesh Logistics Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount, with a P/E ratio of 10.8x compared to the sector benchmark of 17.45x [E1, E6]. This valuation is disconnected from the company’s fundamental performance, as evidenced by a robust 5-year compounded profit growth of 64% and a 3-year compounded profit growth of 110% [E17, E18]. The company consistently generates superior returns, maintaining a 3-year median ROE of 38% and a current ROE of 29%, both of which vastly outperform the sector benchmark of 5.29% [E9, E13, E21]. Furthermore, the operating margin has expanded by 8 percentage points over the last three years, demonstrating a clear trend of increasing operational efficiency [E23, E24]. While the market currently prices the stock for a contraction, a reverse DCF analysis indicates that the current price implies a -0.3% earnings growth, which stands in stark contrast to the company's historical growth trajectory [E38]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with negative operating cash flow of Rs -5 Cr and negative free cash flow of Rs -41 Cr in Mar 2026, alongside a notable institutional outflow [E27, E28, E35]. Despite these liquidity concerns, the intrinsic value suggested by a DCF model at Rs 467 per share highlights a substantial margin of safety of 73.2% at the current market price of Rs 125 [E36, E37].
